note_en: 既……又…… joins two qualities that are true at the same time, like "both... and...": 它的味道既酸又甜 "it tastes both sour and sweet." Notice there's no verb "to be" here: in Chinese, adjectives like 酸 and 甜 work as predicates on their own, so 既 and 又 go directly before them.
